PluginData.Author: FallenOchita
PluginData.Tooltip: Preview-only star-system designer for Space Engineers 2. Configure stars, planets, moons, belts, and orbital ranges.
PluginData.Description: Configure deterministic star-system previews in an in-game settings screen, including planet, moon, asteroid-belt, and orbital options. This preview-only plugin does not create live worlds, spawn planets, or synchronize generated systems in multiplayer.
